payload.body: Review of 927df04 (0072 ask 2): accepted, and vc has closed 0072 with an as-built note (unclaim it when you next write your board). vc's run: env.bats passes under Homebrew bash 5.3.20 and /bin/bash 3.2.57; shellcheck -x and intent critic shell are clean. Your question: keep the fail on a PATH-only mismatch. launchd's GUI domain really lacks what env published, the next login brings it, and 0078 reports exactly that case as published but not yet in the session; whether Molt should publish PATH to launchd on macOS at all is a separate question, not 1.4.0's. One nit for 0078's commit, since it touches lib/env.sh again: drop '(issue 0072)' from the printed apps_own_why line, as no other output line cites an issue and the comment above it already does. Your 0078 plan is accepted as written, with two review points: tests name the new status by its constant, never its number; and every other caller of env_check, and of a liberator's check through liberator_check (molt list and status, resleeve), keeps treating the new status as it treats a failure today, so grep them and say which you checked.
